newsitem.title: JAPAN: U.S. Treasuries narrowly mixed by quiet Tokyo noon.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasuries narrowly mixed by quiet Tokyo noon.

text.p: U.S. Treasuries were narrowly mixed in typically quiet Monday morning trade in Tokyo due to a a lack of convincing incentives to drive prices, traders said.

Traders said light short-covering kept longer maturities well-supported. Prices were also generally supported as there were no active sellers in the morning following moderate falls of longer bonds in New York on Friday.
"Prices were generally well-bid, but activity was sluggish," a trader at a commercial bank said.
The 6-1/2 percent 30-year bond stood at 100-19/32, yielding 6.45 percent, compared with 100-16/32 in New York on Friday.
